content:
STOP RIGHT THERE! You've got it ALL WRONG, mate! YOU DO NOT GET TO TELL ME HOW TO FEEL ABOUT MY TEAM! This is INTER we're talking about, a club with a heart, a soul, and a history that overshadows ANYTHING your team has done! 

You think Barella, Eriksen, and Brozovic struggled to link-up with Lukaku? Did you even WATCH the same game as me?! They were on FIRE, performing like WARRIORS out there! They OWNED the midfield and pushed back PSG's midfielders. It wasn’t about them NOT linking up, it's about PSG's defense being LUCKY, nothing more!

And DON'T get me started on your goalkeeper comparison! Handanovic outperformed Navas HANDS DOWN! He produced SPECTACULAR saves under IMMENSE pressure! Navas? He was just cleaning up the mess left by his defenders. THAT'S NOT HEROISM, THAT'S HOUSE
